description: skillx.release-status/v1 signed status vectors. The test key is derived from a public seed text and MUST NOT be trusted outside tests.
canonicalization: same as skillx.release/v1: padded base64 Ed25519 over the UTF-8 canonical JSON of the status without its signature member; an absent reason is omitted, never null or empty; a served document is exactly the canonical JSON including signature
manifestDigestRule: manifestDigest = 'sha256:' + lowercase hex SHA-256 of the manifest signing payload: the UTF-8 canonical JSON of the skillx.release/v1 manifest without its signature member (the exact bytes its signature covers)
consumerRules: verify the manifest document first (skillx.release/v1 vectors); statuses are checked against that verified manifest
re-encode the received document canonically; any byte difference is status.non_canonical

validate the structure: unknown member unknown_field; missing member required; state outside draft|quarantined|published|yanked status.unknown_state even when signed; reason 1..512 UTF-8 bytes (length, null is type) without Cc, Cf (incl. bidi controls), Zl, Zp or Cs code points (format); issuedAt < expiresAt <= issuedAt + 7 days else status.invalid_lifetime; sequence 1 must be draft or published else status.invalid_transition
require releaseDigest to equal the verified manifest's releaseDigest, else status.digest_mismatch
require manifestDigest to equal the verified manifest's manifest digest, else status.manifest_mismatch
require issuedAt >= the manifest createdAt, else status.issued_before_release
verify the signature with the trusted key for keyId: signature.unknown_key, signature.invalid_key or signature.mismatch
require now <= expiresAt, else status.expired; an expired status may only keep already-installed content, never authorize a new resolution or install

per manifestDigest, against the last accepted status: a lower sequence is status.rollback; the same sequence with different signed bytes is status.conflict (identical bytes are accepted); a higher sequence needs a later issuedAt (status.issued_at_regression) and a state reachable in at most (sequence gap) steps of draft->draft|published, published->published|yanked|quarantined, yanked->yanked|published, quarantined->quarantined|yanked (status.invalid_transition)

testKey.seedText: skillx.release/v1 test vector key; public, never trusted

valid.name: yanked with a reason after the published status
identical re-fetch of the accepted status
first status of another version of the same tree, tracked separately
daily re-sign of the same state
quarantined to published across a skipped sequence (via yanked)

invalid.name: signed by another key under the trusted key ID
member differing from a known one only by case, correctly signed
lifetime longer than 7 days, correctly signed
first status that is yanked, correctly signed
reason over 512 UTF-8 bytes, correctly signed
bidi override in the reason, correctly signed
status of another version of the same tree
issued before the manifest was created
lower sequence than the accepted status (rollback)
higher sequence issued no later (issuedAt regression)
